def process(climateMeasurements):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = climateMeasurements.copy()

    # Drop preamble rows that got read as data (they have 'Site' in first col)
    first_col = df.columns[0]
    df = df[df[first_col].notna() & (~df[first_col].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Site'))]

    # Identify numeric columns (after coercion) and pick a plausible wet-dry index column.
    # Wet-dry index should have both positive and negative values; choose the numeric column
    # with the largest fraction of negative values.
    num = df.apply(lambda s: pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce'))

    neg_frac = (num < 0).sum(axis=0) / num.notna().sum(axis=0)
    # Require at least 1000 non-null to avoid tiny columns
    valid = num.notna().sum(axis=0) >= 1000
    neg_frac = neg_frac[valid]
    wetdry_col = neg_frac.sort_values(ascending=False).index[0]

    # Identify an age/year column: choose numeric column with the widest range.
    rng = (num.max(axis=0) - num.min(axis=0))
    rng = rng[valid]
    age_col = rng.sort_values(ascending=False).index[0]

    tmp = pd.DataFrame({
        'age': num[age_col],
        'wetDryIndex': num[wetdry_col]
    }).dropna()

    # Convert to integer 'years' by rounding age to nearest whole year.
    tmp['year'] = tmp['age'].round().astype('int64')

    # Aggregate if multiple measurements per year
    per_year = tmp.groupby('year', as_index=False)['wetDryIndex'].mean().sort_values('year')

    # Compute year-over-year change
    per_year['delta'] = per_year['wetDryIndex'].diff()
    increasing = (per_year['delta'] > 0).sum()
    total = per_year['delta'].notna().sum()

    pct = (increasing / total) * 100 if total else np.nan
    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'wetDryIndexColumn': str(wetdry_col),
        'ageColumn': str(age_col),
        'nYears': int(per_year.shape[0]),
        'nTransitions': int(total),
        'nIncreasing': int(increasing),
        'percentIncreasing': float(pct)
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute percent of year-to-year transitions where wet-dry index increases: from climateMeasurements, coerce all columns to numeric; drop rows where first column equals 'Site'; select wet-dry index column as numeric column (>=1000 non-null) with highest fraction of negative values; select age/year column as numeric column (>=1000 non-null) with widest range; round age to integer year, average wetDryIndex per year, sort by year, compute diff and percent of deltas > 0; output chosen column names and percentIncreasing.
